focus.title: 美国拟扩大对华芯片设备出口管制，涵盖成熟制程
focus.summary: 据路透社7月19日报道，拜登政府计划进一步收紧对华半导体设备出口限制，将管制范围从先进制程延伸至成熟制程（28nm及以上）。新规可能要求美国供应商在向中国出口特定设备时需申请许可证，并限制美国公民未经许可为中国芯片企业提供技术支持。此举预计影响中芯国际、华虹半导体等企业，中国商务部表示将采取必要措施维护企业权益。
focus.title_en: US Plans to Expand Chip Equipment Export Controls to Mature Nodes
focus.summary_en: According to Reuters on July 19, the Biden administration plans to further tighten export controls on semiconductor equipment to China, extending restrictions from advanced nodes to mature nodes (28nm and above). The new rules may require US suppliers to obtain licenses for exporting specific equipment to China and restrict US citizens from providing technical support to Chinese chip firms without authorization. The move is expected to impact SMIC, Hua Hong Semiconductor, and others; China's Ministry of Commerce stated it will take necessary measures to protect enterprises' rights.

case.title: 新加坡高等法院确认：仲裁庭有权对第三方资助费用作出费用令
case.summary: 在ABC v. XYZ [2026] SGHC 100案中，新加坡高等法院裁定，仲裁庭依据《新加坡国际仲裁法》有权在裁决中要求败诉方承担胜诉方因第三方资助（TPF）产生的费用，包括资助方的利润分成。法院认为TPF费用属于“仲裁费用”范畴，只要资助安排透明且披露充分。该裁决强化了新加坡作为仲裁地的吸引力，也为跨境纠纷中TPF的运用提供了明确的费用追偿路径。
case.title_en: Singapore High Court Confirms Arbitral Tribunal's Power to Order Third-Party Funding Costs
case.summary_en: In ABC v. XYZ [2026] SGHC 100, the Singapore High Court ruled that an arbitral tribunal has the authority under the Singapore International Arbitration Act to order the losing party to bear the winning party's costs arising from third-party funding (TPF), including the funder's profit share. The court held that TPF costs fall within 'arbitration costs' as long as the funding arrangement is transparent and fully disclosed. The ruling strengthens Singapore's attractiveness as an arbitration seat and provides a clear path for cost recovery in TPF arrangements in cross-border disputes.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”机制正式落地深圳前海
policy.summary: 7月15日，深圳市前海管理局发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规定（试行）》，设立“白名单”制度，对经认定的企业及数据类别实施简化安全评估流程。首批名单涵盖金融、医疗、物流等11个行业，符合条件的企业可凭“数据跨境流动备案证明”在区内自由传输非个人数据。该规定自2026年8月1日起施行，为区内企业开展跨境业务提供了便利。
policy.source: 来源：深圳市前海管理局 · 2026.07.15
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Launches 'Whitelist' Mechanism for Cross-Border Data Flow in Qianhai, Shenzhen
policy.summary_en: On July 15, the Qianhai Authority of Shenzhen issued the 'Regulations on the Administration of Cross-Border Data Flow Security in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', establishing a 'whitelist' system that simplifies security assessment procedures for certified enterprises and data categories. The first batch covers 11 industries including finance, healthcare, and logistics. Eligible enterprises may freely transfer non-personal data within the area upon obtaining a 'Cross-Border Data Flow Filing Certificate'. The regulations take effect on August 1, 2026, facilitating cross-border business operations for enterprises in the zone.

analysis.title: 美国对华投资审查新规生效在即，秦林蒿律师研判：企业应尽快完成存量投资合规审查
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部将于2026年8月1日正式实施《对外投资审查规则》，对涉及中国半导体、AI、量子计算等领域的美国投资实施强制申报与禁止。建议出海企业：1）立即梳理现有美国股东及融资结构，评估是否落入受限范围；2）对已签署但未交割的交易，在生效日前完成交割或申请豁免；3）调整未来融资路径，优先考虑非美国资本。企业应保留完整尽调记录，以应对后续核查。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 律连全球 · 2026.07.20
analysis.title_en: US Outbound Investment Review Rules Effective Soon: Attorney Qin's View on Compliance Urgency
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury will implement the 'Outbound Investment Review Rules' on August 1, 2026, mandating filings and prohibitions for US investments in Chinese semiconductors, AI, quantum computing, etc. Practical advice: 1) Immediately review existing US investors and equity structures to assess whether they fall within restricted categories; 2) For signed but unconsummated deals, close before the effective date or apply for an exemption; 3) Adjust future fundraising strategies to prioritize non-US capital. Companies should maintain complete due diligence records for future audits.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · iGlobal Law · 2026.07.20
